snippet.title: Super Scary Cylinder Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Get the game: https://tylrdev.itch.io/super-scary-cylinder
Thanks to @CryoDoctor for editing the trailer

In this terrifying true story, you (super fragile capsule) has to collect 10 super standard spheres before the super scary cylinder catches up to you. Can you survive? Can you get 10 Super Standard Spheres before the Super Scary Cylinder gets you?
